description.value:
You conjure six medium sabotage charges that last for the duration. When cast, and again as a bonus action on later turns, you may hurl up to two charges at points within 120 feet; each detonates on impact with a creature or solid surface. Every creature within 10 feet of a blast makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot above 7th level creates two additional charges per slot level beyond 7th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 7
